pages: Surah Al-Ma'‘oon 107 > name of God, the entirely merciful, the especially merciful

107:1- Have you seen the person who denies the Judgement? 107:2 - That is the one who pushes away the orphan? 107:3 - And does not encourage the feeding of the needy, 107:4 - So woe to those who pray, 107:5 - (But) who are heedless of their prayers
